subject: Consolidate invoicing + remit update after VentureGrid acquisition
messages:
From: Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@sparrowholdings.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Marks <oliver.marks@venturegrid.com>
Date: 2028-03-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: consolidate invoices to Sparrow Holdings (VentureGrid acquisition)

Hi Rafael,

Quick note following the closing — Sparrow Holdings closed on VentureGrid on 2028-03-01. We need all outstanding and future invoices for VentureGrid subscriptions to be billed to Sparrow Holdings (the acquirer) going forward. Our AP team has asked for:

- New legal name on invoice: Sparrow Holdings Ltd.
- Billing address: 12 Regent Plaza, London, SW1A 1AA, United Kingdom
- VAT / Tax ID: GB999888777
- Bank remit: Sparrow Holdings / Sort: 40-12-34 / Account: 12345678 / IBAN: GB29NWBK60161331926819
- PO reference (if applicable): SPW-VG-2028

Can you confirm whether you can reissue the outstanding invoice INV-20280221-137 to Sparrow, and push future invoices to the Sparrow remit? Also please confirm if you need a formal W-9 / tax form from our side or anything else for your records.

I attached our remit instructions and a copy of the merger confirmation for reference. Our AP contact is ap@sparrowholdings.com (procurement lead is Jenna Ortiz).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 15-min call if that helps.

Best,
Jenna Ortiz
Head of FP&A, Sparrow Holdings

Attachments: Sparrow-Remit-Instructions.pdf, Merger_Confirmation.pdf

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@sparrowholdings.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidate invoices to Sparrow Holdings (VentureGrid acquisition)

Hi Jenna — thanks for the heads-up and congrats on the close.

Quick confirmation/questions from our side:
- We can reissue INV-20280221-137 to Sparrow and update the billing record going forward.
- Can you confirm the effective date for the change — is March 1 the date to which we should reassign the outstanding invoice?
- Do you want the original invoice number to be preserved with a reissue stamp or a new invoice number generated?
- We will need a copy of the legal merger confirmation (you attached one — thanks) and AP contact (ap@sparrowholdings.com) in case collections needs to verify.

Looping in Marissa (legal) and Karthik (finance) to confirm any tax/VAT implications for reissuing and how we should mark the invoice (sold-to vs bill-to). I’ll hold payment routing updates until they confirm. If you prefer, we can schedule 15 minutes today to run through specifics.

Thanks,
Rafael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: (none)

From: Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@sparrowholdings.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-03T11:18:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidate invoices to Sparrow Holdings (VentureGrid acquisition)

Hey Rafael —

Effective date is March 1, 2028. Please reissue INV-20280221-137 with Sparrow Holdings Ltd as the billed entity and include the VAT: GB999888777. Preserve the original invoice reference in the description and add a short note: "Reissued to Sparrow Holdings following acquisition of VentureGrid (effective 2028-03-01)". New invoice number is fine if your system requires it — please just flag the link to the old invoice in the PDF.

No W-9 required — the transaction is between two UK entities; if your team needs additional documentation our legal mailbox is legal@sparrowholdings.com.

Thanks for moving quickly on this.

Jenna

Attachments: Merger_Confirmation.pdf

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-04T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: consolidate invoices to Sparrow Holdings (VentureGrid acquisition)

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Sparrow’s remit info. See request below and attachments. Action items I need from you:

1) Legal: confirm wording for reissued invoice header (sold-to vs bill-to language) and whether we need any addendum to the Master Services Agreement for the entity change.
2) Finance: confirm whether we should create a new customer record for Sparrow Holdings or map VentureGrid invoices to Sparrow (ledger mapping + GL code implications). Also confirm VAT handling for GB VAT ID provided.

Outstanding invoice: INV-20280221-137 (originally billed to VentureGrid). Sparrow requests reissue and to be the billed party effective 2028-03-01. Attachments: Merger_Confirmation.pdf, Sparrow-Remit-Instructions.pdf.

I’ll hold payment routing updates until finance confirms.

Thanks,
Rafael

Attachments: (forwarded) Merger_Confirmation.pdf, Sparrow-Remit-Instructions.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-05T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: consolidate invoices to Sparrow Holdings (VentureGrid acquisition)

Thanks for the loop, Rafael. Reviewed the merger confirmation and remit instructions. Proposed approach: 

- Legal is fine with reissuing the invoice to Sparrow Holdings Ltd. Wording we recommend on the invoice: "Sold to: VentureGrid (a subsidiary of Sparrow Holdings Ltd.) — Bill to: Sparrow Holdings Ltd." and include the line: "Reissued following acquisition effective 2028-03-01; original invoice: INV-20280221-137."
- Finance should create a top-level customer record for Sparrow Holdings and map VentureGrid as a child account to preserve historical GL continuity. This will make collections and reporting simpler.
- VAT: With the GB VAT provided, include VAT number on the invoice. If the transaction is a taxable supply in the UK, we will show VAT per usual; if Sparrow requests reverse-charge treatment we’ll need a formal confirmation from their tax team — suggest we ask Sparrow legal if they need reverse-charge language.

I attached a short reissue instruction doc with the precise invoice header and the text to add in the notes field. Once finance confirms mapping and final invoice numbering, Rafael can send reissued PDF to ap@sparrowholdings.com.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Reissue_Instructions.docx

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@sparrowholdings.com>, Sparrow Holdings AP <ap@sparrowholdings.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-06T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidate invoicing + remit update after VentureGrid acquisition — invoices reissued and remit updated

Hi Jenna / AP team —

Confirming completion of the requested changes: 

- We reissued INV-20280221-137 as INV-20280306-291, billed to Sparrow Holdings Ltd with wording per legal guidance: "Sold to: VentureGrid (a subsidiary of Sparrow Holdings Ltd.) — Bill to: Sparrow Holdings Ltd.". The reissued PDF is attached.
- Customer/ledger mapping: VentureGrid has been mapped as a child account under Sparrow Holdings in our billing system. Future invoices will route to the Sparrow remit and use the provided VAT (GB999888777).
- Bank remit updated in our payments portal to Sparrow’s bank details provided. We will flag this in collections for any in-flight payments.

Attachments: INV-20280221-137_reissued.pdf, Sparrow-Remit-Setup-Confirmation.pdf

If you see any discrepancy (VAT display, invoice number, or PO reference), please reply and we’ll fix immediately. I’ll also add a HubSpot note and attach the merger confirmation for your AP team’s records.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — Rafael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: INV-20280221-137_reissued.pdf, Sparrow-Remit-Setup-Confirmation.pdf
